newsitem.title: USA: Citgo will begin Lemont refinery work Monday.
newsitem.headline: Citgo will begin Lemont refinery work Monday.

text.p: Part of Citgo's 160,000 barrel-per-day Lemont, Illinois, refinery will go down for a planned turnaround on Monday, a source familiar with the company said Wednesday.

"Starting Monday the planned maintenance will begin and continue on through to July 26th but it is only a small portion of the plant," said the source, who could not say which portion would be affected.
News of the turnaround, combined with other refinery problems in the region, helped pressure up differentials on prompt unleaded gasoline in the Chicago market.
Citgo Petroleum Corp, is the U.S. unit of Venezuela's state-owned Petroleos de Venzuela SA.
